translations.web: When those who bore Yahweh’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
translations.bsb: When those carrying the ark of the LORD had advanced six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
translations.kjv: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.
translations.asv: And it was so, that, when they that bare the ark of Jehovah had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fatling.
